title: P-RAG: Prompt-Enhanced Parametric RAG with LoRA and Selective CoT for Biomedical and Multi-Hop QA
authors: Xingda Lyu; Gongfu Lyu; Zitai Yan; Yuxin Jiang
why_relevant: Proposes a hybrid parametric+retrieval RAG variant with LoRA and CoT for biomedical QA, mentioning knowledge base quality issues but not directly studying robustness, conflict, or calibration.
why_not_or_caveat: Focus is on QA performance improvements, not on robustness under noisy/adversarial/conflicting evidence or calibration.
